description: This file contains functions for configuring and handling trigger shapes and engine cycle calculations in an engine control system, including specific trigger configurations and event scheduling.

methods.name: getEngineCycle
methods.description: Returns the engine cycle angle based on the operation mode (two-stroke or four-stroke).

methods.name: addSkippedToothTriggerEvents
methods.description: Adds trigger events for teeth on a wheel, accounting for skipped teeth, with specified timing and filters.

methods.name: initializeSkippedToothTriggerShapeExt
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape with skipped teeth, setting synchronization gaps and error handling.

methods.name: configureOnePlusOne
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for a specific engine trigger pattern with primary and secondary events.

methods.name: configureOnePlus60_2
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for a 60-tooth wheel with skipped teeth, setting up event timings.

methods.name: configure3_1_cam
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for a 3/1 cam trigger pattern with multiple event schedules.
